## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `uv lock --check`
- [ ] `uv run --locked pytest`
- [ ] Documentation updated when behavior changed
- [ ] Dependency declarations and `uv.lock` are unchanged, or this is a dedicated dependency PR

## Security and data

Describe any change to credential handling, external requests, document access,
session persistence, or model-visible content.
